description: The rocketeer has a targeted special power (SPECIAL_DEFECTOR style: an enemy unit changes sides), 30 s reload, NEED_TARGET_ENEMY_OBJECT.

edits.append:
SpecialPower SPECIAL_IronwoodConvert
  Enum = SPECIAL_DEFECTOR
  ReloadTime = 30000
  PublicTimer = No
End

CommandButton Command_IronwoodConvert
  Command = SPECIAL_POWER
  SpecialPower = SPECIAL_IronwoodConvert
  Options = NEED_TARGET_ENEMY_OBJECT
  TextLabel = CONTROLBAR:Beacon
  ButtonImage = SP_Rocketeer
End

CommandSet IronwoodRocketeerCommandSet
  1  = Command_AttackMove
  2  = Command_Guard
  3  = Command_Stop
  4  = Command_IronwoodConvert
End

edits.find:
CommandSet = IronwoodCombatCommandSet
  Locomotor = SET_NORMAL IronwoodInfantryLocomotor
  Prerequisites
    Object = IronwoodBarracks
  End
  BuildCost = 250
edits.replace:
Behavior = DefectorSpecialPower ModuleTag_Convert
    SpecialPowerTemplate = SPECIAL_IronwoodConvert
    FatCursorRadius = 0.0
  End
  CommandSet = IronwoodRocketeerCommandSet
  Locomotor = SET_NORMAL IronwoodInfantryLocomotor
  Prerequisites
    Object = IronwoodBarracks
  End
  BuildCost = 250
